title: Apex Friendship High School
subtitle: Boston, MA June 19-23, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Apex Friendship High School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Boston, MA & Freedom Trail

  • Travel to Boston, MA!
  • Guided Walking Tour of the Freedom Trail
  • Lunch Allocation at Quincy Market
  • Guided Duck Boat Tour
  • Visit Old North Church
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Hotel Accommodations with overnight security (four nights)
 

Day 2: Pilmoth Patuxet Museum & Pilgrim Memorial State Park

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Plimoth Patuxet Museum
  • Boxed Lunch 
  • Visit Pilgrim Memorial State Park 
  • Time Along Water Front
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: Walden Pond State Reservation & Old North Bridge

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Walden Pond State Reservation
  • Boxed Lunch
  • Visit the Old North Bridge
  • Visit the Boott Cotton Mills Museum
  • Riverboat Tour
  • Dinner and Games at Level 99!
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Smithsonian National Zoological Park & United States Capitol Building

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Walk the Cliff Walk from Narragansett Ave/Forty Steps to the Breakers/Ruggles Ave
  • Visit the Breakers Newport Mansion
  • Group Exploration of Bowen’s Wharf
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the Fort Adams State Park 
  • Rail Explorer Adventure in Rhode Island
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 5: Harvard University & Black Heritage Trail

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Guided Tour of Harvard University
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Ranger Guided Walking Tour of the Black Heritage Trail
  • Visit Boston Tea Party and Ships Museum
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: Apex Friendship High School, get ready for an unforgettable Boston adventure in 2027!
introText: From revolutionary history to world-class universities, this Boston, Massachusetts experience brings the past and future together in one incredible trip. Students will walk the iconic Freedom Trail, relive history at the Boston Tea Party Ships and Museum, and explore the storied campus of Harvard University. They'll also discover powerful stories along the Black Heritage Trail, take in the charm of Quincy Market, and enjoy an unforgettable Duck Boat Tour through the heart of the city. It's the perfect mix of education, inspiration, and excitement — an experience your students will never forget!
